name: Gasthof Au
beschreibung: The Gasthof Au in Ellmau presents itself as a traditional inn in the Wilder Kaiser region. The accommodation is located in a quiet side location of the village. The house offers well-kept guest rooms with typical Tiroler furnishings. In the attached restaurant, regional and seasonal dishes are served. The immediate surroundings are characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Wilder Kaiser. Hikers and mountain bikers can reach numerous routes directly from the house. In winter, the ski areas of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental are easily accessible. The Gasthof's furnishings combine alpine country style with practical functionality.
